# LLM.txt — Escriba Documents: XML → PDF

Machine-readable authoring reference for `@escriba/documents`.

You (the LLM) produce **one XML file**. Escriba parses it and renders an A4 PDF
with the `document` template. Do not produce PDFs, HTML, Markdown, base64 images
or signatures: the renderer adds the seal, QR code, barcode and electronic
signature automatically.

**Scope:** only the `document` template (proposals, roadmaps, acts, letters,
notes). The `invoice` template is a different format and is **not** covered here.

---

## 1. How the XML becomes a PDF

The file lives in `apps/documents` (run commands from that directory; fonts and
seals are loaded from `./public`).

**CLI** — the command name is `document` (singular):

```bash
bun run cli.tsx document \
  --file ./input/proposals/proposal.xml \
  --seal blue \
  --output ./proposal.pdf
```

| Flag | Alias | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--file` | `-f` | yes | — | Path to the XML file. Must exist. |
| `--seal` | `-s` | no | `blue` | `black`, `blue`, `gold`, `green`, `orange`, `pink`, `purple`, `raw`, `red`. |
| `--output` | `-o` | no | `./output.pdf` | Output PDF path. |

**HTTP API** — returns `application/pdf`:

```http
POST /api/documents
Content-Type: application/json

{ "xml": "<Document>...</Document>", "seal": "blue" }
```

`xml` and `seal` are both required by the API. The API accepts only
`red`, `blue` and `green`. The seal is the colored stamp used on the cover and
in the signature block.

---

## 2. Golden rules

1. **One root element:** `<Document>`. Nothing before or after it (no `;`, no
   BOM, no text, no second root).
2. **Tag names are case-sensitive** and must match this document exactly.
3. **Every visible string must live inside a text-capable tag**
   (`Title`, `Paragraph`, `Text`, `BulletText`, `Bold`, `Italic`, `S` or `Cell`).
   Text placed directly inside `Section`, `Indent`, `Paginate`, `Table` or `Row`
   is invalid or dropped.
4. **Escape XML special characters.** In text and attributes:
   `&` → `&amp;`, `<` → `&lt;`, `>` → `&gt;`. Inside attributes also
   `"` → `&quot;` (or use `'` around the value). A raw `&` aborts rendering.
5. **Attributes are auto-converted:** `"true"`/`"false"` become booleans,
   numeric strings become numbers, everything else stays a string. Prefer
   `"true"`/`"false"` over `"1"`/`"0"` for clarity.
6. **No HTML.** Never use `<br>`, `<b>`, `<i>`, `<p>`, `<ul>` or CSS.
7. **No images in the body.** The only images are the automatic seal/QR/barcode.
8. **Do not invent tags.** Unknown tags are silently unwrapped (their children
   are kept), so a typo can silently lose meaning.
9. **Spanish content**, unless the user explicitly asks for another language.
10. **Comments** (`<!-- ... -->`) are allowed and ignored.

---

## 3. Minimal valid document

```xml
<Document title="Documento de prueba" language="es">
  <Paginate>
    <Section marginTop="0">
      <Title size="md">Hola mundo</Title>
      <Paragraph>Este es el contenido mínimo.</Paragraph>
    </Section>
  </Paginate>
</Document>
```

---

## 4. Document skeleton

Only `Cover` and `Paginate` are meaningful direct children of `Document`.

```xml
<Document
  subject="Propuesta Económica"
  title="Título del documento"
  author="Joan Andrés Buriticá Salazar"
  keywords="Propuesta, Fase"
  creator="Joan Andrés Buriticá Salazar"
  producer="React PDF with Bun"
  language="es"
>
  <!-- Optional cover page (recommended) -->
  <Cover
    type="Propuesta Económica"
    title="Propuesta de Valor, Landing Page"
    month="Marzo 2026"
  />

  <!-- One <Paginate> per page group; content flows automatically across pages -->
  <Paginate>
    <IndicatorHeader value="Ing. Joan A. Buriticá" />
    <!-- Optional: <BorderDecoration /> -->

    <Section marginTop="0" gap="0.1cm">
      <!-- date / addressee -->
    </Section>

    <Section>
      <Title size="xs" textAlign="left">Introducción</Title>
      <Paragraph>...</Paragraph>
    </Section>

    <!-- more sections / tables -->

    <SignSection>
      <SignRow>
        <SignMeLeft />
        <SignMeRight />
      </SignRow>
    </SignSection>
  </Paginate>
</Document>
```

Page model:

- `Cover` is its own page. Omit it if the document must start with body content.
- Each `Paginate` is an A4 page. Its content **overflows automatically** onto
  more pages; you do not need to split manually.
- Fixed elements (`IndicatorHeader`, `BorderDecoration`) appear on every page
  generated by that `Paginate`.
- If you add a **second** `<Paginate>`, it starts a hard new page and does not
  inherit fixed elements; repeat `IndicatorHeader` there if you need it.

---

## 5. Component reference

### 5.1 `<Document>` — root

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `subject` | string | recommended | PDF metadata subject. **Correct spelling is `subject`**, not `subjet`. |
| `title` | string | recommended | PDF metadata title. |
| `author` | string | recommended | Author. |
| `keywords` | string | optional | Comma-separated keywords. |
| `creator` | string | optional | Creator metadata. |
| `producer` | string | optional | Producer metadata. |
| `language` | string | recommended | BCP-47-ish code, e.g. `es`. |

Children: `Cover` (0..n) and `Paginate` (1..n). A document without at least one
`Paginate` renders nothing visible.

```xml
<Document
  subject="Propuesta Económica"
  title="Landing Page"
  author="Joan Andrés Buriticá Salazar"
  keywords="Proposal, Phase, Fedelta Mall"
  creator="Joan Andrés Buriticá Salazar"
  producer="React PDF with Bun"
  language="es"
>
```

---

### 5.2 `<Cover>` — cover page

Self-closing. Renders the dark cover page with the fixed header
`ING. JOAN A. BURITICÁ`, the colored seal, a QR code, a barcode, the UUID and a
vertical serial. All of those are generated by the system; do not pass them.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | yes | Category, large italic line: `Propuesta Económica`, `Hoja de Ruta`, `Acta de Reunión`, `Requerimiento`, ... |
| `title` | string | yes | Main title, large uppercase serif. |
| `month` | string | yes | Small label at the bottom, e.g. `Marzo 2026`. |
| `scaleTitle` | number | optional | Multiplier for the title size (base `52pt`). Default `1`. Use `0.75`–`0.9` for long titles. |

```xml
<Cover
  type="Propuesta Económica"
  title="Landing Page"
  month="Marzo 2026"
/>

<Cover
  type="Propuesta Económica"
  title="Ecosistema Web Headless &amp; Portafolio Administrable"
  scaleTitle="0.8"
  month="Julio 2026"
/>
```

---

### 5.3 `<Paginate>` — page

A4 page with a cream background (`#FFF8E7`), body font `Geist` at `11pt`.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paddingVertical` | length | `2cm` | Top and bottom padding. |
| `paddingHorizontal` | length | `2.5cm` | Left and right padding. |

Any block component can be its child. Other style attributes on `Paginate` are
**not** applied; if you need layout changes, use them on `Section` instead.

---

### 5.4 `<Section>` — block group

The main layout unit. Defaults: `marginTop: 1cm` and `gap: 0.5cm` between
children. It keeps itself whole on one page unless `wrap` is enabled.

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `wrap` | boolean | `false` | `true` allows the section to break across pages. Use it for long sections. |
| `marginTop` | length | `1cm` | Set `0` for the first section on a page. |
| `gap` | length | `0.5cm` | Space between children. |
| any style | style | — | Any other attribute is applied as a style (e.g. `paddingBottom`, `marginBottom`, `flex`, `justifyContent`). |

Children: `Title`, `Paragraph`, `Text`, `BulletText`, `Indent`, `Table`,
`Fragment`. Text directly inside `Section` is **not allowed**.

```xml
<Section marginTop="0" gap="0.1cm">
  <!-- compact metadata block -->
</Section>

<Section wrap="true">
  <!-- long content that may span pages -->
</Section>
```

---

### 5.5 `<Indent>` — indented block

A container with a left margin. Accepts any block children (usually
`Paragraph` or `Bold`).

The left margin is computed as **`level × scaleOffset` centimeters**:

| `level` | `scaleOffset` | Resulting `marginLeft` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `1` (default) | `1` (default) | `1cm` |
| `2` | `1` (default) | `2cm` |
| `3` | `1` (default) | `3cm` |
| `2` | `0.5` | `1cm` |
| `1` | `2` | `2cm` |

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | number | `1` | Indentation step. Each step adds `scaleOffset` cm: `1` → `1cm`, `2` → `2cm`, and so on. |
| `scaleOffset` | number | `1` | Multiplier that controls how much the margin grows per level. `0.5` halves the growth, `2` doubles it. |
| any style | style | — | Additional style attributes. An explicit `marginLeft` overrides the computed margin. |

```xml
<Indent>
  <Paragraph>
    <Text bold="true">Eficiencia Operativa</Text>: descripción del eje.
  </Paragraph>
</Indent>

<Indent level="2">
  <Paragraph>Dos niveles: 2cm.</Paragraph>
</Indent>

<Indent level="3" scaleOffset="0.5">
  <Paragraph>Tres niveles con escala 0.5: 1.5cm.</Paragraph>
</Indent>
```

---

### 5.6 Text components

All text components share these attributes:

| Attribute | Type | Applies to | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `xs` \| `sm` \| `md` \| `lg` \| `xl` | `Text`, `Paragraph`, `Bold`, `Italic` | Font size. `xs=7pt`, `sm=8pt`, `md=9pt`, `lg=10pt`, `xl=12pt`. Default inherits `11pt`. |
| `size` | `xs` \| `md` \| `lg` \| `xl` | `Title` | `xs=10pt`, `md=12pt`, `lg=14pt`, `xl=16pt`. Default `xl`. |
| `bold` | boolean | `Text`, `Paragraph` | Semi-bold (weight `semibold`, opacity `0.9`). |
| `italic` | boolean | `Text`, `Paragraph` | Italic. |
| `textAlign` | `left` \| `center` \| `right` \| `justify` | `Text`, `Paragraph`, `Title` | Alignment. `Title` defaults to `center`; `Paragraph` forces `justify`. |
| `opacity` | number | `Text`, `Paragraph` | `0`–`1`. |

#### `<Title>`

Section heading. `Merriweather` bold, dark blue (`#14192f`), centered by
default, `marginBottom: 0.4cm`, with a slight vertical scale.

Only `size` and `textAlign` are applied as layout attributes. Use `xs` for
normal section headings, `md` for numbered sections (`I.`, `II.`) and the
default `xl` for very prominent headings.

```xml
<Title size="xs" textAlign="left">Introducción</Title>
<Title size="md">I. Objetivo del Documento</Title>
```

#### `<Paragraph>`

Justified body text. Supports inline children and all `Text` attributes.

```xml
<Paragraph>
  Texto justificado. Puede contener <Text bold="true">énfasis</Text> y
  <Text italic="true">cursivas</Text>.
</Paragraph>
```

#### `<Text>`

Body/inline text. Can be nested inside `Paragraph`, `Text`, `Bold`, `Italic`,
`BulletText` and `Cell`. It may contain plain text plus inline children.

```xml
<Text>
  <Text bold="true">Fecha:<S /></Text>
  Marzo, 13 de 2026
</Text>
```

#### `<BulletText>`

A bullet dot followed by justified text. **Attributes on `BulletText` are not
applied** (they are ignored); style inline children instead. It is not split
across pages, so keep each bullet reasonably short.

```xml
<BulletText>
  <Text bold="true" opacity="0.8">Fidelidad Visual</Text>:
  El desarrollo será un reflejo exacto de la línea gráfica.
</BulletText>
```

#### `<Bold>` / `<Italic>`

Inline shortcuts equivalent to `<Text bold="true">` and
`<Text italic="true">`.

```xml
<Bold>Landing Page (Frontend)</Bold>
<Italic textAlign="center">Espacio dejado en blanco intencionalmente</Italic>
```

#### `<S />`

Renders a single literal space. Use it to guarantee separation at the end of an
inline element, where XML whitespace would otherwise be trimmed:

```xml
<Text>
  <Text bold="true">Dirigido a:<S /></Text>
  FEDELTA HOLDING S.A.S.
</Text>
```

---

### 5.7 Tables

Structure:

```xml
<Table>
  <Header>
    <Row>
      <Cell flex="2">Concepto</Cell>
      <Cell>Valor</Cell>
    </Row>
  </Header>
  <Body>
    <Row>
      <Cell flex="2">Programación, Optimización y Pruebas</Cell>
      <Cell textAlign="right">840.000 COP</Cell>
    </Row>
  </Body>
  <Footer>
    <Row>
      <Cell flex="2">Inversión Total</Cell>
      <Cell textAlign="right">0 COP</Cell>
    </Row>
  </Footer>
</Table>
```

| Tag | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `Table` | Plain container. No attributes. |
| `Header` | Shaded header band. It is **fixed**, so it repeats on every page when the table breaks. No attributes. |
| `Body` | Transparent wrapper (optional). Rows can also be direct children of `Table`. |
| `Footer` | Shaded footer band. Not fixed. No attributes. |
| `Row` | One horizontal row with borders. **Attributes on `Row` are ignored.** A row with a single `Cell` spans the full width. |
| `Cell` | A text cell. Content must be inline (text, `Text`, `Bold`, `Italic`, `S`). It **cannot** contain `Paragraph`, `Table`, `Section`, etc. |

`Cell` attributes (any style attribute also works):

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `flex` | number | `1` | Column width proportion. Use `flex="2"` for a wider column. |
| `textAlign` | `left` \| `center` \| `right` | inherit | Cell alignment. |
| `width`, `color`, `fontSize`, ... | style | — | Any React-PDF style. |

Keep the **same number of cells per row** in a table; otherwise columns will not
line up. Empty cells are fine: `<Cell />`.

---

### 5.8 Signature block

Place it as the last child of the last `Paginate`. It fills the remaining
vertical space and pushes the signatures to the bottom.

```xml
<SignSection>
  <SignRow>
    <SignMeLeft />
    <SignMeRight />
  </SignRow>
</SignSection>
```

| Tag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `SignSection` | Signature container. Shows the centered title `Elaborado y Firmado` unless hidden. Accepts style attributes (`marginTop`, `paddingTop`, ...). |
| `SignRow` | One signature line. Accepts style attributes, commonly `gap` and `height`. |
| `SignMeLeft` | **Joan's** signature block: colored seal + phone + email. Optional `scale` number (default `1`; use `0.6`–`0.8` for compact pages). Requires no XML data. |
| `SignMeRight` | **Joan's** personal signature: script name, credentials and professional license. Fixed content. No attributes. |
| `SignPad` | Empty slot. Optional `side` (`left` \| `right`). Use it as a spacer in a row. |
| `SignPadLeft` | Generic signature line on the left. Attributes: `signBy` (label, required), `withSign` (optional handwritten name text; when present no line is drawn), `empty` (`true` to leave it blank). |
| `SignPadRight` | Same as `SignPadLeft`, aligned right. |

`SignSection` attributes:

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hiddenTitle` | boolean | `false` | `true` hides `Elaborado y Firmado`. |

Default (Joan only):

```xml
<SignSection hiddenTitle="true" marginTop="0" paddingTop="0">
  <SignRow>
    <SignMeLeft scale="0.6" />
    <SignMeRight />
  </SignRow>
</SignSection>
```

Bilateral (third parties + Joan):

```xml
<SignSection hiddenTitle="true">
  <SignRow gap="25pt" height="120pt">
    <SignPad />
    <SignPadRight signBy="Firma Liz Alexandra, Representante REAM" />
  </SignRow>

  <SignRow gap="25pt" height="120pt">
    <SignPadLeft signBy="Firma Ricardo Suarez, Representante REAM" />
    <SignMeRight />
  </SignRow>
</SignSection>
```

---

### 5.9 Fixed and decorative components

#### `<IndicatorHeader value="..." />`

Centered, fixed header line in red (`#b50000`) with a bottom rule. It repeats on
every page of its `Paginate`. Place it as the first child of `Paginate`.

- `value` (string, optional): defaults to `Ing. Joan A. Buriticá`.

#### `<VerticalSerial />`

Renders the document UUID vertically along the page edge. Self-closing, no
attributes. Usually placed right after `IndicatorHeader`.

#### `<BorderDecoration size="200" />`

Optional decorative corner marks on all pages. `size` is a number in points
(default `200`). Place it as a child of `Paginate`, before the content.

```xml
<Paginate>
  <BorderDecoration />
  <IndicatorHeader />
  ...
</Paginate>
```

---

### 5.10 `<Fragment>` and unknown tags

`<Fragment>` is a transparent wrapper (maps to a React Fragment). Any other
unknown tag is also unwrapped: its children are kept in place. Do not rely on
this; use only the tags documented here.

---

## 6. Style attributes

On `Section`, `Indent`, `Text`, `Paragraph`, `Bold`, `Italic`, `Cell`,
`SignSection` and `SignRow`, any attribute that is not a documented special prop
is applied as a **style**. Write style properties in camelCase.

| Group | Examples |
| --- | --- |
| Spacing | `margin`, `marginTop`, `marginBottom`, `marginLeft`, `marginRight`, `padding`, `paddingTop`, `paddingBottom`, `paddingHorizontal`, `gap` |
| Layout | `flex`, `flexDirection`, `justifyContent`, `alignItems`, `alignSelf`, `width`, `height`, `minWidth`, `minHeight`, `maxWidth`, `position`, `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left` |
| Borders | `borderWidth`, `borderTopWidth`, `borderBottomWidth`, `borderColor`, `borderRadius` |
| Typography | `fontFamily`, `fontSize`, `fontWeight`, `fontStyle`, `lineHeight`, `letterSpacing`, `textAlign`, `textTransform`, `textDecoration`, `opacity`, `color` |
| Background | `backgroundColor` |
| Transform | `transform` (string, e.g. `"rotate(90deg)"`, `"scaleY(1.4)"`) |

Value rules:

- Lengths: `"12pt"`, `"0.5cm"`, `"2mm"`, `"1in"`, `"50%"`. A bare number is
  points (`"10"` = 10pt).
- Colors: hex strings, e.g. `"#14192f"`.
- Numbers/booleans are auto-coerced (`marginTop="0"` → `0`, `bold="true"` →
  `true`).
- **Do not use a `style` attribute** with a JSON/object value; it will not parse.
  Use individual attributes.

Available fonts: `Geist` (body), `InstrumentSerif` (cover category),
`Merriweather` (titles), `Roboto`, `RockSalt`, `MonsieurLaDoulaise` (signature).
Use fonts only when you really need to; the defaults are already correct.

---

## 7. Whitespace and inline text rules

- Newlines and indentation inside text are collapsed to a single space; text is
  trimmed at the edges of its text node.
- A space is preserved when a text node sits directly next to an element. Use
  `<S />` when you need an explicit space at the end of an inline element.
- Never put meaningful text directly inside `Section`, `Indent`, `Paginate`,
  `Table`, `Row`, `SignSection` or `SignRow`.
- `Cell` content is inline only. Split long cell content into short phrases or
  use several cells/rows.
- Avoid tabs and non-breaking spaces; use plain spaces.
- Currency: write it literally, e.g. `$ 9.975.000 COP` or `840.000 COP`.
- Dates in Spanish, e.g. `Marzo, 13 de 2026` or `Marzo 2026`.

---

## 8. Recipes

### 8.1 Date / addressee block

```xml
<Section marginTop="0" gap="0.1cm">
  <Text>
    <Text bold="true">Fecha:<S /></Text>
    Marzo, 13 de 2026
  </Text>

  <Text>
    <Text bold="true">Dirigido a:<S /></Text>
    FEDELTA HOLDING S.A.S.
  </Text>
</Section>
```

### 8.2 Section with intro, bullets and a closing paragraph

```xml
<Section wrap="true">
  <Title size="xs" textAlign="left">Valor Estratégico</Title>

  <Paragraph>
    Texto introductorio de la sección.
  </Paragraph>

  <BulletText>
    <Text bold="true" opacity="0.8">Legitimidad y Profesionalismo</Text>:
    descripción del primer punto.
  </BulletText>

  <BulletText>
    <Text bold="true" opacity="0.8">Adaptabilidad Total</Text>:
    descripción del segundo punto.
  </BulletText>

  <Paragraph>
    Cierre de la sección.
  </Paragraph>
</Section>
```

### 8.3 Pricing / comparison table

```xml
<Table>
  <Header>
    <Row>
      <Cell flex="2">Concepto</Cell>
      <Cell>Inversión Anterior</Cell>
      <Cell>Nueva Inversión</Cell>
    </Row>
  </Header>
  <Body>
    <Row>
      <Cell flex="2">Programación, Optimización y Pruebas</Cell>
      <Cell>840.000 COP</Cell>
      <Cell>0 COP</Cell>
    </Row>
    <Row>
      <Cell flex="2">Alojamiento y Despliegue Técnico</Cell>
      <Cell>Incluido</Cell>
      <Cell>0 COP</Cell>
    </Row>
  </Body>
  <Footer>
    <Row>
      <Cell flex="2">Inversión Total Fedelta</Cell>
      <Cell />
      <Cell>0 COP</Cell>
    </Row>
  </Footer>
</Table>
```

### 8.4 Long content that must span pages

Use `wrap="true"` on the section. Long tables break automatically; `Row` never
splits and `Header` repeats.

```xml
<Section wrap="true">
  <Title size="xs" textAlign="left">Alcance detallado</Title>
  <Paragraph>...</Paragraph>
  <Table>...</Table>
</Section>
```

### 8.5 Hard page break

Add a second `<Paginate>` after the first one. Repeat the indicator header if
needed:

```xml
<Paginate>
  <IndicatorHeader />
  <!-- page 1 -->
</Paginate>

<Paginate>
  <IndicatorHeader />
  <!-- page 2 -->
</Paginate>
```

---

## 9. Complete example

Golden template. Copy it and replace the text, keeping the structure.

```xml
<Document
  subject="Propuesta Económica"
  title="Propuesta de Valor, Landing Page"
  author="Joan Andrés Buriticá Salazar"
  keywords="Propuesta, Landing Page"
  creator="Joan Andrés Buriticá Salazar"
  producer="React PDF with Bun"
  language="es"
>
  <Cover
    type="Propuesta Económica"
    title="Propuesta de Valor, Landing Page"
    month="Marzo 2026"
  />

  <Paginate>
    <IndicatorHeader value="Ing. Joan A. Buriticá" />

    <Section marginTop="0" gap="0.1cm">
      <Text>
        <Text bold="true">Fecha:<S /></Text>
        Marzo, 13 de 2026
      </Text>

      <Text>
        <Text bold="true">Dirigido a:<S /></Text>
        FEDELTA HOLDING S.A.S.
      </Text>
    </Section>

    <Section>
      <Title size="xs" textAlign="left">Introducción</Title>

      <Paragraph>
        He seguido de cerca el progreso de las propuestas enviadas en enero y
        desearía que la Landing Page tuviera un camino sin obstáculos. Por ende,
        asumiré este proyecto como una iniciativa de valor agregado para
        fortalecer nuestra alianza.
      </Paragraph>
    </Section>

    <Section wrap="true">
      <Title size="xs" textAlign="left">Valor Estratégico</Title>

      <Paragraph>
        La solución se centrará en entregar una plataforma de alta gama técnica
        que soporte la visión de la compañía:
      </Paragraph>

      <BulletText>
        <Text bold="true" opacity="0.8">Legitimidad y Profesionalismo</Text>:
        una página funcional que sirva como carta de presentación oficial.
      </BulletText>

      <BulletText>
        <Text bold="true" opacity="0.8">Adaptabilidad Total</Text>:
        la información se leerá perfectamente en cualquier dispositivo.
      </BulletText>
    </Section>

    <Section wrap="true">
      <Title size="xs" textAlign="left">Cronograma e Inversión</Title>

      <Paragraph>
        Para asegurar que este proyecto avance sin fricciones, los términos del
        compromiso son:
      </Paragraph>

      <Table>
        <Header>
          <Row>
            <Cell flex="2">Concepto</Cell>
            <Cell>Inversión Anterior</Cell>
            <Cell>Nueva Inversión</Cell>
          </Row>
        </Header>
        <Body>
          <Row>
            <Cell flex="2">Programación, Optimización y Pruebas</Cell>
            <Cell>840.000 COP</Cell>
            <Cell>0 COP</Cell>
          </Row>
          <Row>
            <Cell flex="2">Alojamiento y Despliegue Técnico</Cell>
            <Cell>Incluido</Cell>
            <Cell>0 COP</Cell>
          </Row>
        </Body>
        <Footer>
          <Row>
            <Cell flex="2">Inversión Total Fedelta</Cell>
            <Cell />
            <Cell>0 COP</Cell>
          </Row>
        </Footer>
      </Table>

      <Paragraph>
        <Text bold="true">Tiempo de Entrega</Text>:
        el sitio estará funcional en un plazo de 1 a 2 semanas hábiles.
      </Paragraph>
    </Section>

    <SignSection>
      <SignRow>
        <SignMeLeft />
        <SignMeRight />
      </SignRow>
    </SignSection>
  </Paginate>
</Document>
```

---

## 10. Validation checklist

Before returning the XML, verify:

- [ ] Exactly one `<Document>` root, nothing before/after it.
- [ ] All tags are from this reference and correctly closed.
- [ ] All `&` written as `&amp;`; no raw `<` or `>` in text/attributes.
- [ ] Every string is inside a text tag (`Cell` counts).
- [ ] `Cover` (if used) has `type`, `title` and `month`.
- [ ] `Document` uses `subject` (not `subjet`).
- [ ] `SignSection` is the last block of the last `Paginate` (if signatures are needed).
- [ ] Long sections/tables use `wrap="true"`.
- [ ] No `invoice` tags, no images, no `style` JSON attributes.

Common renderer errors and their cause:

| Error | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| `Document source cannot be empty or null` | Empty or whitespace-only XML. |
| `Unescaped character detected (like a raw &)` | A raw `&` in text or an attribute. Use `&amp;`. |
| `Tag structural error` | Mismatched or unclosed tags. |
| `Text strings must be rendered within a <Text> component` | Plain text directly inside `Section`, `Row`, `Paginate`, etc. Wrap it in `Paragraph`/`Text`. |
| Nothing appears for a tag | The tag is unknown and was unwrapped, or its text was whitespace-only. Check spelling and casing. |
